title: C natural

nodes.title: C natural
nodes.body: One fingering. Hear it, then hold it. If it will not seal, that is the remark. We do not offer a second fingering until this one disagrees on this stick.

nodes.title: C inside a phrase
nodes.body: The same fingering, between notes you already have. Play from the start of the line.

source: One fingering that speaks on this whistle: the top hole open, the next two closed, the bottom three open. Checked once. No half-hole menu.
